releases.name: Tivano 1.3.1
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v1.3.1/Tivano-1.3.1.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

If Tivano 1.0.2 or earlier reports HTTP 403 while checking updates, install this DMG manually once. Later checks use public static feeds and do not require a GitHub login.

## Bug fixes

- Bring back the composer's and floating controls' Liquid Glass look, now pinned to its active appearance so it no longer whitens when switching back to Tivano.

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
